_comment: T-017 — the data-protection engine's runtime configuration (07-DATA-PROTECTION.md §10).
Every value here is read through back-end/src/common/data-protection/data-protection.config.ts,
which validates it and falls back to the SAME defaults written below if the file is missing or
malformed. The defaults are deliberately the restrictive ones: logging.defaultTreatment is
'omit' and response.defaultVisibility is 'masked', because 'someone will notice a missing field
in the UI immediately; nobody notices a leaked field for months' (§10).
This file contains NO key material and no credentials (AGENT-PROTOCOL R4). Keys are named by
reward_portal.encryption_keys.key_ref, which points at an env var or a KMS ARN — see T-016.
Rollback for T-017 is 'enabled: false' here, then remove the module. Rows already encrypted
stay encrypted: turning the engine off stops the afterFind hook decrypting them, so those
columns read back as 'v1.…' ciphertext rather than reverting to plaintext.
